Author: MusicManBowls
Name: Parley
Punchline: A tabbed messenger for tells, your free company, linkshells and cross-world linkshells.
Description: Keeps every tell, your free company, and each linkshell and cross-world linkshell in its own conversation, grouped under tabs with a sidebar to switch between them. Remembers history per character, counts what you have not read, shows which tells are with friends and whether they are online, busy or in a duty, and plays a sound of your choosing for each kind of chat. Clickable links, item tooltips, search, symbols and pop-out windows included. Can follow Dalamud's style, the game's UI theme or your Umbra colour profile, and an optional Umbra companion adds a toolbar widget that shows unread messages.
